nodes.description: Identify the session/agent under review (session ID). Grounded in `/kya status <session_id>` — trust score + identity binding for a session (.claude/commands/kya.md).
Run `/kya status <session_id>` and read the Inference Jurisdiction Score (IJS), 0-100, computed at session start and re-evaluated on every provider switch. Route to the matching IJS tier.
IJS 90-100, Sovereign tier — fully EU-compliant, on-prem or EU-only inference (e.g. DGX Spark Espoo, IJS 100). KYA+I action: None. Terminal — no incident.
IJS 70-89, Compliant tier — meets Art. 12 + GDPR for high-risk AI. KYA+I action: Minor gap remediation. Terminal — no incident, log the remediation note.

IJS 40-69, Partial tier — OK for limited-risk AI, not for high-risk. KYA+I action per the IJS table: disclose to customer, get written acceptance. Re-check trust after remediation, or park if acceptance is refused.

IJS 0-39, Exposed tier — CLOUD Act exposure or no DPA, unacceptable for EU enterprise. KYA+I action: block or escalate to C-level. A confirmed active incident (TRUST_VIOLATION, POLICY_BREACH, CONTAINMENT_BREACH, or inference-jurisdiction reason codes) proceeds to a TC-4 Leash Snap; otherwise this is a blocked/parked terminal.

Preview the TC-4 leash snap without executing: `/kya snap <session_id> --reason <CODE> --dry-run` — SAFE, use first. Per the skill's safety rule, do NOT run a real snap without a dry-run preview unless the situation is an active incident.
Human confirmation step the skill doc requires before a real snap: confirm the session ID once more in plain text, and require the human to type the session ID back before running without --dry-run.

DESTRUCTIVE. The real TC-4 Leash Snap: `/kya snap <session_id> --reason <CODE> [--force-cascade] --yes`. Chain termination with forensic dump, audit-logged server-side. Reachable ONLY via SNAP_DRY_RUN -> SNAP_CONFIRM, mirroring how HIC_APPROVAL_GATE -> SEND is the only path to SEND in sales-outreach.graph.json.
Terminal — incident closed, forensic dump location recorded.
Terminal for this run, re-enterable later (e.g. customer acceptance pending, or Exposed-tier session blocked without an active-incident snap).
